questions.question: During the night, Jacob wrestled with a man beside the Jabbok River. When the man could not overpower Jacob, what did he do?

answers.text: Struck the socket of Jacob's hip
Let go and slipped off into the dark

questions.question: After Jacob wrestled with a man all night, what new name did the man give him?
After wrestling all night, Jacob asked the man his name. What did the man do for Jacob there?
After wrestling a man all night, Jacob named the place Peniel. What reason did he give?

answers.text: He had seen God face to face and his life was spared
He had won the hardest fight of his whole life
He had finally made peace with his brother Esau
